title: View Permissions button next to role selector opens the Permission Summary
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Staff Page Role Assignment
expected: Read-only Permission Summary opens showing Parts Manager's full permission set
actual: In Edit Staff Member modal, selected 'Parts Manager' in Role select, clicked the eye (View Permissions) icon beside it. A read-only modal titled 'Parts Manager — Permissions' opened showing the full permission set (Work orders View/Create&Edit checkboxes, View mode Full View, Review work orders/Pick parts/Order parts toggles, Work order lines, Schedule, Customers, etc.). Toggles/checkboxes render display-only.
reason: Behavior matches: View Permissions control opens read-only permission summary for the selected role (Parts Manager) showing its full permission set.

title: Staff page role dropdown groups roles into System Roles and Custom Roles sections
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Staff Page Role Assignment
expected: Dropdown shows two grouped sections: 'System Roles' with all 12 built-in roles, and 'Custom Roles'
actual: Role dropdown in Edit Staff Member modal DOES show two grouped sections with headers 'SYSTEM' and 'CUSTOM'. title: Changing user's role triggers immediate forced logout
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Staff Page Role Assignment
expected: Step 3: user forced to login immediately; Step 4: after re-login new-role perms in effect
actual: Held an authenticated Tech session (Time Clock, 3 perms, /api/auth/me/fe-permissions=200). As Admin changed Tech's role to Technician (201). The held session's very next request immediately returned HTTP 409 'Session has expired.' (at +0ms, +1.5s, +3s). A fresh Tech login then returned the new Technician perms (7, view_mode=tech). Restored Tech to Time Clock afterward.
reason: Behavior matches: role change immediately invalidates the user's existing session (409 Session has expired) forcing re-login; after re-login the new role's permissions are in effect.

title: Logged-in user is immediately kicked when their role changes
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Staff Page Role Assignment
expected: User's next action redirects to login page immediately
actual: With an active held Tech session, Admin changed Tech's role. The held session's immediate next request returned HTTP 409 'Session has expired.' with no delay, i.e. the user is kicked and the next action redirects to login.
reason: Behavior matches: the active session is immediately invalidated on role change; next action forces login.

title: Failed role change preserves the previous role
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Staff Page Role Assignment
expected: Step 2: on failure an error toast appears; Step 3: previous role PRESERVED (change did not persist)
actual: Tech on Time Clock (3 perms). As Admin, submitted a role change with an invalid role_id; server returned HTTP 500 error (error payload -> FE surfaces error toast). Re-checked Tech: still Time Clock (3 perms, view_mode null) — the failed change did NOT persist.
reason: Behavior matches core assertion: a failed role-change save returns an error (5xx) and the previous role is preserved. Exact error-toast wording not visually captured (the case itself notes a genuine server-error string can't be triggered on demand); a real 5xx failure was produced and preservation confirmed via API.
